name: Lab 85 -- Race Condition (Limit Overrun): a single-use gift code's redeemed check races its own write, so concurrent redemptions all get credited.
notes: Local lab on port 5085. Copy this preset to project.json in a fresh directory, then launch NullockApp --project=<absolute-directory>. Start the lab separately with python app.py. Advanced scope restricts traffic to localhost or 127.0.0.1 on this port.
